lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: Right. I'm going to do the unusual thing and take the meeting.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: For the record, because there is no record: I am not doing this because you frightened me. I am doing it because in eleven minutes you have described my own future to me in more detail than my board has managed in two years, and I would like to see it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The founding chair of Meridian walks off his own campus two days before the vote and does not come back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He does not upload in 2091, because he is not there to. The fourth chair is still occupied in 2312 — but it is an open question now by whom.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: You have brought him with us.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The seat is filled either way. Somebody sits in it. I would rather have the man who signs the thing where I can see him than find out in three hundred years who took his place.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: This is the worst decision anybody has made in four centuries, and I have now been to four centuries, so I'm speaking from a position of some authority.
